dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日本医師会標準レセプトソフト); likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux given ORCA project conventions
evidence: COPY copybooks with .INC extension typical of ORCA
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM PIC X(256)
SELECT ... ASSIGN RECEUPD with LINE SEQUENTIAL
No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt/レセプト) processing — specifically a monthly billing summary for Niigata wide-area combined diagnosis claim (新潟・広域連合・診療報酬請求書)
purpose.summary: SOKATU1515 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that generates a monthly insurance claim summary report. It reads receipt update files, aggregates claim counts, days, points and amounts by insurer/public-expense payer category, and writes formatted output for submission to insurers. It handles multiple public-expense payer (公費) combinations and high-cost medical expense delegation billing.

notable_features: UNSTRING COMMAND-PARAM DELIMITED BY comma for parameter parsing
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM (called as subprogram or via shell)
OCCURS tables for insurer/public-expense aggregation (up to 100 entries)
No COMP-3 usage despite numeric accumulation
High comment ratio (~30%) with Japanese (EUC-JP encoded) comments
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in EUC-JP (displayed as latin-1 mojibake in the snippet); Japanese comments are readable in context. File is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA project. Truncated at 16000 chars; full file is 2209 lines. No COMP-3 is unusual for numeric aggregation but consistent with ORCA style.
